battle.name: 高平之戰
battle.brief: 顯德元年三月，後周世宗柴榮親征北漢，與劉旻部將張崇徹在晉南高平對壘。周軍前鋒初挫，柴榮斬退將七十餘人肅軍紀，親冒矢石督戰，精騎突入中軍射殺張崇徹，擊潰北漢三萬之眾，乘勝圍太原，五月拔晉陽，劉旻僅以百餘騎遁走。將士戴兜鍪頓項、護面而視野受限，正合卡面科林斯盔「靠隊形活」之道。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 交戰方是並立於五代十國北端的兩個政權：後周與北漢。後周承後漢而入主中原，都大梁（汴州），樞密院掌軍令，侍衛親軍分殿司、馬軍、步軍三支為禁軍主力，地方則有相、魏、潞、澤等節鎮聽調；河東尚在北漢手中，正是後周頭號心腹之患。北漢由劉旻於951年在晉陽（太原）建國，國號仍稱漢，只領太原府及河東數州之地，兵源、財賦與馬匹皆嫌不足，向北依賴契丹；但契丹遼世宗耶律璟於954年崩逝，幼主穆宗即位、蕭太后臨朝，北方自顧不暇，北漢的外援一時虛弱。兩個政權都承五代的兵制：兵是藩鎮牙兵與中央禁軍的混合體，節度使掌鎮兵、樞密使掌調兵，戰時仍須臨機授權，主將常須親至前線。這正是高平一役雙方都要靠主帥親臨陣前、靠陣前斬將立威才能打的原因。
countriesEn: The belligerents were two states facing each other at the northern end of the Five Dynasties: Later Zhou and Northern Han. Later Zhou had inherited the Later Han's place in the Central Plains, with its capital at Daliang (Bianzhou). The Bureau of Military Affairs issued the orders, the Palace Guard was split into the diansi, cavalry and infantry wings as the core of the imperial army, and the regional commands at Xiang, Wei, Lu and Ze obeyed its summons; as long as Hedong stayed in Northern Han hands, it was the gravest internal threat to Later Zhou. Northern Han had been raised by Liu Min in 951 at Jinyang (Taiyuan), keeping the name Han, and controlled only Taiyuan prefecture and a few counties of Hedong; its manpower, revenue and horses were all thin and it leaned northward on the Khitan, but the Liao emperor Yelu Jing died in 954, the boy-emperor Yelu Ruan took the throne under the regency of Empress Dowager Xiao, and the north had to look to itself, so for a moment Northern Han's outside support went hollow. Both states ran on the mixed military system of the Five Dynasties: troops were a blend of regional command garrisons and a central palace guard, the jiedushi held the soldiers and the grand marshal moved them, and in wartime both sides still had to delegate command on the spot, which is why the battle of Gaoping turned on both commanders standing in the front rank and on discipline restored by beheading officers in view of the army.
people: 後周方面的核心是剛即位的世宗柴榮。他自幼隨父柴守禮與郭威在軍中行走，即位後整軍、選將、汰弱，真正決定高平勝負的是他一次又一次站到矢石之前的作為：樊愛能所部前鋒初接即退，他不因老臣而姑息，當陣收七十餘人一律斬之；其後自領精騎直衝中軍，把潰散的禁軍重新帶回陣線。行營副將張永德在亂軍之中射殺北漢主帥張崇徹，殿都虞候趙匡胤率精騎扈衛、乘勢追奔，也都在這一戰中嶄露頭角；趙匡胤其後執掌殿司禁軍，構成十年後陳橋兵變的制度前提。北漢方面，劉旻以劉知遠同母弟的身分在晉陽建國，力圖承接後漢法統，但用人不疑而臨陣易搖，大將張崇徹被寄以全軍之望，卻在高平城下中流矢而亡，軍無主而遂崩。攻晉陽之際，劉旻焚宮室、開門夜遁，僅攜百餘騎出城，其後數年棲身宋州、兗州一帶，終以病亡收場，由弟劉鈞繼位。
peopleEn: The central figure on the Later Zhou side was the newly enthroned Emperor Shizong, Chai Rong. He had grown up in the barracks with his father Chai Shouli and with Guo Wei, and once he was on the throne he reorganised the army, chose his commanders and culled the weak; what actually decided Gaoping was his repeated willingness to stand in front of the missiles. When Fan Aineng's vanguard gave way at the first contact, he did not spare old generals out of sentiment but took more than seventy of them and had them all beheaded on the spot; then he led his own picked cavalry into the enemy centre, dragging the dissolving palace guard back into line. Zhang Yongde, deputy of the northern field command, shot the Northern Han commander Zhang Chongche down amid the confusion, and Zhao Kuangyin, then commandant of the palace guard, led the cavalry escort and pressed the pursuit, so both men made their name in this battle; Zhao's later control of the diansi guard was the institutional seed of the Chenqiao mutiny a decade later. On the Northern Han side, Liu Min had founded his state at Jinyang as the full brother of Liu Zhiyuan, intending to inherit the Later Han's legitimacy, but he was generous with trust and changeable at the moment of contact: Zhang Chongche, on whom the whole army depended, was struck down by an arrow before Gaoping, and the force collapsed for want of a commander. When Jinyang was besieged, Liu Min burned his palace buildings, broke open the gates and rode out with no more than a hundred horsemen; he spent the following years drifting around Songzhou and Yanzhou, died of illness, and was succeeded by his younger brother Liu Jun.
kits: 卡面這件科林斯青銅盔出自公元前650年前後的希臘城邦科林斯，是阿卡迪亞式重裝步兵的全覆式頭盔：整塊青銅錘打成形，只留眼孔與鼻脊，兩側垂下護頰，常插馬鬃冠飾。它並未出現在高平的戰場上，這一點必須說明；寫它在這一戰的位置，是要指出它所代表的那一類頭部防具——「護住頭面，便只能靠隊形活」的設計取捨——在河東戰場上同樣成立。後周軍中功能相近的，是唐以來沿用的兜鍪加頓項，再配面襖、面巾之類遮面裝具：鐵盔皮胎，前後垂頓項護住頸背，覆面擋箭鏃與刀刃，代價是視野收窄、轉向遲緩，士卒一旦脫離隊形便難以自保。其餘裝備以長槊、步槊、長刀與弓弩為主，步軍用槊矛結陣，弩手混編在步兵之間，禁軍另有披膊、護臂與鎖子甲，甲片來自回鶻、吐蕃與波斯方向，騎兵因要承受衝撞而配備更重的披膊與馬具；攻城靠雲梯、撞竿、飛梯與鹿角拒馬，糧秣由汴京沿汴河、黃河車運北下，馬匹自河南、河北徵集，汾河漕運被切斷則北漢太原立陷糧荒。
kitsEn: The Corinthian bronze helmet on the card was made in the Greek city-state of Corinth around 650 BC, the fully enclosing headgear of Arcadian-style heavy infantry: a single piece of bronze beaten into shape, with only eye holes and a nose ridge, cheek pieces hanging down at the sides, and usually a horsehair crest set on top. It did not stand on the field of Gaoping, and that has to be said plainly; placing it in this battle means pointing to the class of head protection it represents - the bargain in which covering the face and head forces a man to live by his formation - and that bargain held on the Hedong field too. The Later Zhou equivalent was the dhelmet-and-thong-kit carried down from the Tang: an iron shell on a leather liner, the thong trailing fore and aft to cover neck and nape, and a face screen or face cloth to turn aside arrowheads and blades, paid for with a narrowed field of vision and slow turning, so that a soldier who lost his place in the line could no longer save himself. The rest of the equipment was long spears, step-spears, long sabres, bows and crossbows; infantry fought in spear-and-pike formations with crossbowmen intermingled, and the palace guard also carried shoulder plates, arm guards and mail, the mail plates coming from the Uighur, Tibetan and Persian directions. Cavalry, which had to absorb the shock of the charge, wore heavier shoulder pieces and harness. Siege work used scaling ladders, battering poles, flying ladders and antlered barricades; grain came north from Daliang by wagon along the Bian and Yellow Rivers, horses were levied in Henan and Hebei, and once the Fen River grain traffic was cut the Northern Han capital at Taiyuan was in trouble for food.
tactics: 北漢的部署是一場孤注式的野戰決決勝。劉旻把主力壓在高平，等於把澤州門戶完全暴露：一旦高平失守，晉陽便無遮蔽，所以他傾力出城，把張崇徹所部步騎列於高平一帶的開闊地，企圖以密集陣形一次吃掉遠道而來的周軍，斷其糧道於晉陽城下。北漢的前鋒與後援之間沒有縱深，一旦被突破便各自潰散，統帥中軍與大隊脫節，遂成全線崩盤之局。後周的打法是五代典型的精騎決勝：先以步兵與前鋒試敵，見勢不利便不問軍情、只問軍法，斬將立威；然後柴榮自領中軍精騎直取敵方帥旗所在，張永德一箭射落張崇徹，敵我士氣同時崩解，眾隨帥旗而倒。周軍不設中途歇腳，追奔二百餘里直抵晉陽，四月合圍，五月因大雨汾水暴漲、城牆被淹而破城，奪取北漢經營多年的根本重鎮；圍城之際周軍切斷汾水漕運，使太原糧援斷絕，逼得劉旻焚城夜遁。
tacticsEn: Northern Han's plan was a single desperate decision in the open field. By pushing his main force to Gaoping, Liu Min exposed the gateway of Zezhou completely: if Gaoping fell, Jinyang lay uncovered. So he marched out with everything, drew up Zhang Chongche's infantry and cavalry on the open ground around Gaoping, and hoped a dense formation would swallow the Zhou army that had marched a long way from the south, while cutting its supply route off before Jinyang. Northern Han had no depth between vanguard and reserves; once it was pierced, each part broke up on its own, the command centre came adrift from the mass, and the whole line came apart. Zhou's method was the classic Fifth Dynasty decision by picked cavalry. Infantry and the vanguard probed first; when the going went against them the answer was not to argue about the fighting but to enforce the articles of war, and officers were beheaded in sight of the ranks to set the tone. Then Chai Rong took the cavalry of the centre straight at the place where the enemy banner stood, Zhang Yongde's arrow brought Zhang Chongche down, and the morale of both sides broke at once, the mass following its commander into flight. The Zhou army did not pause on the pursuit: it rode two hundred odd li to Jinyang, closed in during the fourth month, and took the city in the fifth when great rain sent the Fen River over its walls and drowned the defences, winning the root stronghold Northern Han had built up over years. During the siege Zhou cut the Fen grain traffic, so that food no longer reached the city and Liu Min was driven to burn his palace and ride out in the night.
data: 可核的數字有限，且各方記載互有出入，宜保守看待。《資治通鑑》記北漢張崇徹所率步騎三萬，另有說法稱四萬、五萬，多半是壯敵之辭；周軍總數史無明文，只知以精騎為衝鋒骨幹，前有步兵推進，後有禁軍壓陣，總量當亦在數萬之數。斬獲方面，通鑑只說斬首數千級、張崇徹以下死者甚眾，並無精確傷亡表；降卒數千，被收編後與北漢本部混成。行程上，從大梁出師到高平歷時數百餘里，戰後自高平追奔至晉陽又二百餘里；高平至晉陽之間為太行東麓谷道，軍隊只能循河谷北進，追擊速度因此受限。圍城自四月至五月，前後約四十餘日；劉旻出城時僅餘百餘騎。時間成本則是柴榮即位兩個月便打完一場跨州遠征的大戰，糧秣消耗與戰馬折損雖無數字可考，但從其圍城月餘仍能維持大軍於城下推算，供應線的效率遠勝此前五代諸役。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are few, and the sources disagree, so they should be read conservatively. The Zizhi Tongjian records that Zhang Chongche led thirty thousand infantry and cavalry for Northern Han, while other versions say forty or fifty thousand, most probably to overstate the enemy. The total strength of the Zhou army is nowhere recorded; we know only that picked cavalry formed its striking core, with infantry pushing in front and the palace guard pressing from behind, so the whole must also have been in the tens of thousands. On losses the Tongjian says only that several thousand heads were taken and that many were killed below Zhang Chongche, with no exact table of casualties; several thousand surrendered men were folded into the Zhou army and mixed with the Northern Han formations already serving. As for distance: the march from Daliang to Gaoping ran for several hundred li, and the pursuit from Gaoping to Jinyang covered another two hundred odd li. Between Gaoping and Jinyang the road follows the valleys along the eastern foot of the Taihang range, so troops could only advance by the river valleys, and that limited the speed of the pursuit. The siege of Jinyang ran from the fourth to the fifth month, some forty-odd days in all; when Liu Min broke out he had no more than a hundred horsemen left. As for the cost in time, Chai Rong fought a war across several circuits within two months of his accession; the grain consumed and horses lost are not recorded in numbers, but the fact that he could keep a large army under the walls for more than a month implies a supply line far more efficient than those of the earlier Five Dynasties campaigns.
cause: 北漢的存在本身就是後周必須解決的問題。劉旻於951年乘後漢崩解之際在晉陽稱帝，沿用漢的國號，佔據河東要地，等於在中原之北立起一面拒馬；後周要推行天下一統的大業，不可能容許這樣一個割據政權長期存在。954年柴榮即位，正值兩個窗口同時打開：一是他自己整軍集權、汰除禁軍老弱、換入精壯，禁軍久疏戰陣，需要一場硬仗立威，也需要一位能壓住驕兵的主帥；二是北方契丹的遼世宗在位時正當盛年，一旦崩逝，幼主臨朝、蕭太后與諸部勢力互相牽制，北方必然自保，北漢得不到外援。戰略上，高平是澤州的門戶、晉陽的南面屏障，澤州不取，晉陽永遠握在北漢手中；反之若晉陽先破，澤州、高平一線自北崩落。周軍因此選了最硬的路線：不取小城、不圖近功，直趨太原，用高平的一次野戰決勝負去換整個河東。
causeEn: Northern Han's very existence was a problem Later Zhou had to solve. In 951, as the Later Han fell apart, Liu Min had proclaimed himself emperor at Jinyang, kept the name Han and seized the key ground of Hedong, which was like raising a barrier in the north of the Central Plains; a Later Zhou that meant to carry out the great business of unifying the realm could not allow such a breakaway state to stand for long. In 954, when Chai Rong came to the throne, two openings happened to fall together. First, he had reorganised the army and gathered power into his own hands, culled the old and weak out of the palace guard and put in fresh and strong men; the guard had long been rusty at fighting, it needed a hard battle to make its name and needed a commander able to hold down unruly soldiers. Second, the Liao emperor in the north had been in his prime, and once he died, with a child on the throne and Empress Dowager Xiao and the various tribal powers pulling against one another, the north would necessarily be occupied with its own survival, and Northern Han would get no help from outside. Tactically, Gaoping was the gateway of Zezhou and the southern screen of Jinyang: without Zezhou, Jinyang stayed in Northern Han's hands for ever, while if Jinyang fell first, the Zezhou and Gaoping line would collapse from the north. Zhou therefore chose the hardest road - no minor cities, no easy prizes, straight for Taiyuan, to win all of Hedong with one open-field decision at Gaoping.
impact: 高平一役的影響，遠大於它本身的戰果。北漢自此只剩晉陽與數州之地，割據的根基盡失，劉旻靠舊日姻親與殘部支撐的政權名存實亡，此後再無能力反攻，最終在979年為宋所滅，五代末年北方最後一個割據政權就此落幕。後周則由此確立了兩樣東西：一是軍紀，高平之後柴榮在整軍之外更著手修撰軍律，把賞罰條文寫成可援引的準繩，禁軍從此不再是一群各懷心事的藩鎮老卒，而是一支聽令的中央武力；二是將才，趙匡胤在這一仗中以精騎衝陣之功嶄露，柴榮把殿司交給這批年輕武人，五代那種兵隨將、將隨鎮的舊例開始鬆動，十年後的陳橋兵變正是從這支禁軍裡生出來的。柴榮本人的聲望則空前，北漢既平，南唐之役與北伐契丹接踵而來，四年之間後周疆域自河南拓至淮南、漢北與關南，北方大業的規模隱約已現；只是959年他病逝澶州，壯志未竟。
impactEn: The effect of Gaoping was far larger than the battle's own results. Northern Han was left with Jinyang and a few prefectures, the foundation of its separatism was gone, and the state that Liu Min had propped up on old kinship ties and a rump following him existed in name only. It never mounted another offensive, and in 979 it was destroyed by Song, the last separatist regime in the north of the late Five Dynasties closing its file. Later Zhou, for its part, established two things. The first was discipline: after Gaoping, Chai Rong not only kept reorganising the army but had the articles of war drawn up, turning rewards and punishments into a text that could be cited, so that the palace guard was no longer a mob of old regional soldiers with their own private thoughts but a central force that obeyed orders. The second was command: Zhao Kuangyin made his name in this battle charging with the picked cavalry, and Chai Rong put the diansi guard in the hands of these younger officers, so that the old Fifth Dynasty practice of soldiers following their general and generals following their command began to loosen - and the Chenqiao mutiny ten years later grew out of exactly that guard. Chai Rong's own prestige reached its height: with Northern Han settled, the campaign against Southern Tang and the expedition against the Khitan followed one another, and within four years Later Zhou's territory reached from Henan to south of the Huai, north of Han and south of the passes, the outline of the great northern enterprise already visible. Only in 959 did he die of illness at Chanzhou, his work unfinished.
result: 高平作戰的全部結果可以一句話收束：北漢三萬之眾一敗而潰，張崇徹中矢身亡，周軍斬首數千、降卒數千，張永德以一箭定下勝負；北漢經營十五年的根本之地晉陽被圍四十餘日，終因大雨淹城而破，劉旻焚宮室夜遁，僅以百餘騎走，多名將吏率眾出降，周軍入城，獲甲兵、馬匹、糧秣無算。勝負的代價同樣落在自己一方：樊愛能等七十餘名將校被斬於陣前，禁軍自此再不敢言退；柴榮乘勝而還，並未據河東，北漢仍保晉陽及數州，名義上仍是敵國，實則一擊之後再無反擊之力。從全局看，柴榮以一次高平換來了三次北征的資格：高平之後南征南唐、繼而北伐契丹、再南征南漢，後周的國勢由此節節上推，直到959年他病逝、960年陳橋兵變，五代十國的格局被徹底改寫，才算真正走到終局。
resultEn: The whole outcome of the fighting at Gaoping can be summed in one line: Northern Han's thirty thousand broke at the first impact, Zhang Chongche was killed by an arrow, Zhou took several thousand heads and several thousand prisoners, and Zhang Yongde settled the business with a single shot. The root stronghold that Northern Han had built for fifteen years, Jinyang, was besieged for more than forty days and finally fell when great rain drowned the walls; Liu Min burned his palace and rode out by night with no more than a hundred horsemen, and several commanders and officials came out and surrendered, while Zhou's troops entered the city and took armour, weapons, horses and provisions beyond counting. The price of the victory fell on the winner as well: Fan Aineng and more than seventy other officers were beheaded in front of the ranks, and the palace guard never again dared speak of retreat. Chai Rong returned in pursuit of his victory without occupying Hedong; Northern Han still held Jinyang and a few prefectures and remained an enemy state in name, yet after that single blow it had no strength left to counterattack. Seen whole, Gaoping bought Chai Rong the right to make three campaigns: the march against Southern Tang after Gaoping, then the expedition against the Khitan, then the march against Southern Han, and Later Zhou's power climbed step by step from there, until his death in 959 and the Chenqiao mutiny in 960 rewrote the whole map of the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms and carried the age to its true end.
